column1: # Egypt, the General Authority for Survey (ESA), as Dar al-Ifta republishes it (profiles-tested.md,
# data-gulf-egypt): each town's table read from Dar al-Ifta's monthly GetPrayer (September 2026), its
# Wayback month tables and ESA's own daily all-cities page (Wayback, 2024–2026). Only days from
# 1 January 2025 on are read (format daily-from-2025): ESA changed its method between its December
# 2024 and January 2025 captures. The fast begins at the printed Fajr (F+E). Standard Asr.
# Each town is checked at its unit's point (Cairo's is ESA's own, fitted; the others the app's, or
# the town centre for the five towns not in the app's list).
# Split, across the country (the research's split B): the national margins are fitted on eleven
# towns (Cairo, Alexandria, Aswan, Sallum, Halaib, Rafah, Luxor, Port Said, Edfu, Damietta, Suez)
# and held out on eleven others and on Dahab, Nuweiba, Saint Catherine, Farafra and Shalatin.
# Kharga, Ras Gharib and Taba, whose ESA points sit well off the town, keep margins of their own,
# fitted on their own days (nothing held out there).
